selection_policy: Six actual retained candidates: two per original catalog scaffold. Prioritize existing phenyl/pyridyl side chains, then use retained chemically substantive side-chain contrasts where those alternatives do not exist. Select by source graph/provenance before observing any refinement result; no new candidate generation, geometry tuning or simple-compound substitution.
selection_scope: Selected records are from the actual complete Qwen r1 final Design evaluation. Availability was inspected across retained Qwen r1/r2 and E2B r1 organic outputs. The catechol pyridyl candidate is the isolated organic generation output of an interface-oriented case, not an interface-placed/relaxed geometry.

original_rubric.suite_scope_limit: Each target passes the original substantive per-target predicate. This six-target cohort is not the original 130-case model suite and cannot meet or replace its aggregate minimum 12 Murcko families/three-size-band coverage requirements. All selected targets fall in the 13-20 heavy-atom band; catalog scaffold IDs and nonstereochemical Murcko connectivity families are separately recorded.

freeze_policy: Bind cohort_hash and exact target.geometry.geometry_hash before a gradient/optimization attempt. Preserve failures and every actual attempt. Do not replace these coordinates, candidates or states after performance/precision results are observed; any change requires a new explicit cohort version and provenance.
scientific_limits: Coordinates are original RDKit ETKDGv3 seed-42 generated conformers, not measured or optimized geometries.
No reference energy, force, optimized geometry, physical trajectory, local-minimum or precision claim is invented.
Singlet is the explicit upcoming admitted state of an even-electron nonradical neutral graph, not a measured ground-state determination.

Original study_hash is preserved as its content-addressed identifier. Original records have no separate species-registry or study-ID field; molecule object IDs and species identity hashes are preserved without inventing those IDs.

Worker must independently bind exact source/candidate/geometry, actual runtime/basis/effective settings, attempts and outputs. Profile registration and graph validation do not authorize a calculation.
